_comment: Provenance registry for every numeric claim the paper makes.
A number is REGISTERED when it appears here; it is VERIFIED only when someone
opened the artifact, re-derived the value BLIND, and recorded who and when.
Registered-but-unverified is the normal resting state and is not a defect.
Silently absent is the defect, and scripts/check_number_provenance.py finds those.
'recorded-not-rederived' means a predecessor wrote the arithmetic and nobody
reopened the artifact. It is the WEAKER honest claim and is always preferable
to marking it verified on the strength of matching a written-out denominator.
See memory: recorded provenance is more dangerous than absent provenance.
